column3: “commandments” is plural for the Hebrew singular “commandment”; NASB supplies “to give.”
“everything that proceeds out of” renders “every utterance of”; “man” renders “humankind.”
“a man disciplines his son” renders “anyone disciplines his child”; “was disciplining” renders the participle “is disciplining.”
“brooks” renders “torrents”; “fountains and springs” renders “springs and deeps”; “valleys and hills” renders the Hebrew singulars.
“When” renders “And”; “for the good land” renders “on account of the good land.”
“Otherwise, you may say” renders “and you say”; “made me” renders “has acquired for me.”
“makes to perish” renders “is about to destroy.”
